༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (ka)pa'i dkar chag/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (ka)pa'i dkar chag /

ka rang gi tshul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho nas smras pa gsong po'i dga' ston/ kha dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba chos kyi grags pa'i rnam par thar pa'i cha shas tsam brjod pa/ ga skyes rabs las brtsams pa'i gsol 'debs dri ma med pa padma'i phreng ba dad pa'i mdzes rgyan/ nga skyes rabs gsol 'debs mos gus kyi ba dan g.yo ba/ 315 ca rang gi skyes pa'i rabs kyi gtam brjod pa bsil zer 'od kyi phreng ba/ 321 cha skyes rabs padma'i phreng ba'i thog mar gyur pa sgyu ma mkhan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ 343 ja gsol 'debs mtshan dkar gyi ba dan rnam par rol pa'i sgra dbyangs/ 361 nya mthong snang phran bu sgyu ma'i grong khyer lta bu/ 367 ta rang gi gnas tshul nyams mtshar du bkod pa'i tho/ 443 tha bye ri stag rtser zla gsang gi bsnyen sgrub zhig bgyis pa'i tshe 'khrul snang du byung ba bden par bzung nas bris pa/ 451 da gshin rje sogs lhag pa'i lha 'ga' zhig bsnyen pa'i tshe dngos nyams rmi lam byung ba'i rim pa kha shas/ 461 na drang srong loka tri pā la'i bsnyen mtshams kyi zhal gzigs/ 477 pa brag dkar lha chur tshe sgrub bgyis dus mthong snang byung tshul/ 507 pha gsung mgur gyi thog ma lcam skal ldan la gnang ba sogs/ 513 ba rang gis rang la bskul ba keng shu ka'i 'dab ma rlung bskyod ces bya ba/ 521 ma dngul gyi gter kha brtag pa sogs lung bstan gyi skor/529 tsa me sprel zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin ti sgro'i zhing skyong sna tshar du lung bstan sa stod smad bar gsum gyi skad cha sna tshogs/ tsha mgon po 'bri gung pa'i gdung rabs dang gdan sar byon tshul mdor bsdus dper brjod dang bcas pa padma'i phreng ba/ 565 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (kha)pa'i dkar chag / ka jo bo shākya mu ni la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bstod pa/

1 kha 'phags pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod pa/ 9 ga bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag gsal bar bkod pa chos kyi rnam grangs legs par rtogs byed/ 11 nga bka' 'gyur bzhengs dus dpon yig rnams kyi bca' yig 175 ca gnam gyi bu jing gir gyi rgyal rgyud a bu btsun pas bzhengs pa sher phyin la sogs pa'i dkar chag181 cha rje maṅga la'i mtshan can gyi dngul gdung rnam par rgyal ba'i mchod rten gyi dkar chag195 ja gzhi gsum gyi cho ga'i lag len dang ngag 'don bsdus pa thar pa'i gru chen/ 219 nya 'phags pa thams cad yod par smra ba'i dge tshul gyi tshig le'u byas par mchan bus gsal ba/ 267 ta gaṇḍi'i rnam par bzhag pa chos kyi rnga sgra rnam par bsgrags pa/ 343 tha rdzogs dus go ba'i brda sprod tshangs pa'i glu dbyangs/ 349 da yang ri 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i bca' yig thar pa'i lam ston/ 355 na gzhan gyi rgol ngan 'joms pa'i legs bshad lung rigs smra ba'i mgul rgyan/ 377 pa kha rag bde chen thar pa gling gi gnas bstod dad ldan snying la dga' ster ku mu da'i phreng ba/ 439 pha rgyang me'i gnas yig rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dga' ston/ 449 ba rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa lnga pa chen por phul ba'i zhu yig471 ma sde brgyad la springs pa'i yi ge/ 481 tsa bang ri gter ston 'ja' tshon snying por gnang ba'i lam yig 487 tsha mnga' ris su gu ge mi dbang chen po dang ru thog rgyal po la gnang ba'i chab shog491 dza chab shog gi rim pa/ 497 wa snying gtam so lnga pa/ 513 zha ring lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya/ 523 za 'dra chos bcu bdun gyi dper brjod drug skyes ga zha'i phreng ba/ 539 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (ga)pa'i dkar chag / ka dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rnam bshad lung don gsal byed legs bshad nyi ma'i snang ba/ 1 kha dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' 'grel tshigs su bcad pa mun sel sgron me/ 383 ga theg chen bstan pa'i snying po'i khrid yig bstan pa'i yang snying ngam nor phreng mdzes rgyan/

479 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (nga)pa'i dkar chag / ka ja mchod gtsug gi nor bu/ 1 kha bsang rngan gyi cho ga nyes pa rnams sel dgos 'dod kun 'grub/ 7 ga bsang rngan gyi cho ga mdor bsdus dge legs kyi rol mtsho/ 75 nga bsang shin tu bsdus pa/ 83 ca nor lha dang dman pa'i chu sbyin brul gtor dang gtor ma brgya rtsa'i cho ga rnam 'dren sbyin pa'i shing rta sogs gtor chog gi rim pa/ cha gtor ma brgya rtsa'i cho ga mdor bsdus/ 109 ja 'jam dpal chab gtor mdor bsdus tshogs gnyis kyi gru chen/ 115 nya drang srong dri med la chu gtor 'bul ba tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs mchod pa'i sprin/ 133 ta 'byung bzhi'i gtor ma dam pa sangs rgyas kyi lugs yang dag pa/ 141 tha rje btsun sa skya pa'i phyag bzhes dkar cha bzhi/ bar do cha bzhi/ klu gtor bsdus pa/ 151 da klu gtor rgyas pa sbyin pa'i lang tsho nā ga me na ka163 na cha gsum gtor ma mdor bsdus phrin las 'grub byed/ 185 pa gtor bsngos bsdus pa/ 193 pha gtor bsngos nyung ngu phrin las kun 'grub/ 199 ba bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma'i gtor bsngos chung ngu*/ 205 ma chos kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor gtor ma la brten nas bskang zhing gsol ba/ 209 tsa bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma'i glang po'i cho ga bzang ngan brtag pa/ 215 tsha dud sol lha mo'i gtor chog paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen lugs mkha' 'gro myos pa'i nga ro / 231 dza rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser po zhi ba bde byed sgrub cing mchod pa'i las rim dngos grub kyi rgya mtsho/ 255 wa dbul sel nam mkha'i bang mdzod gter gyi snye ma/ 285 zha gza' bdud kyi rlung gi 'khor lo'i las byang*/ 307 za gza' bdud dug gi spu gri'i las byang ngag sgrig bstan dgra 'joms pa'i rdo rje/ 373 'a lha chen tshangs pa'i gsol mchod phrin las kyi shing rta/ 385 ya chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po bzhi'i gsol kha/

395 ra lha chen nag lha dzaṃ bha'i bsang mchod/ 415 la ra khyim klu btsan gyi gsol mchod bsdus pa/ 433 sha rnga thug rten 'dzugs las mthun kun 'grub/ 437 sa dkyil 'khor spyi'i thig rtsa nyi ma'i snang ba/ 447 ha bde gshegs chos sku'i mchod rten brgyad kyi thig rtsa byin rlabs kyi 'od phreng*/ 415 a sa bdag lto 'phye chen po brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa nyes pa kun sel/ 473 ki ring bsrel lnga'i gzhug tshul lag len tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho/ 487 ku nam mkha'i sad srung nyi zla 'od sprin gyi lo glud zab mo/ 537 ke rang lugs kyi rnga grangs/ 547 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (ca)pa'i dkar chag / ka nor bu bstan pa'i spyi dbang bskur tshul rje yab sras kyi phyag len bklag chog ma/ 1 kha sgrub thabs rgya mtsho nas nye bar phyung ba sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba'i rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ 33 ga sgrub thabs nor bu'i phreng ba'i lhan thabs gser gyi pa ṭa/ 97 nga bla ma zhi drag gi lo rgyus shin tu bsdus pa/ 119 ca bla ma zhi drag gi las byang dang gtor dbang shin tu bsdus pa/ 127 cha bla ma drag po padma gling pa'i lugs kyi rjes gnang mdor bsdus/ 143 ja rdo rje tshe'i phrin las/ 153 nya 'chi med tshe'i dbang chog 183 ta sgra mi snyan gyi tshe sgrub 'khrul snang du slob dpon chen po'i drung du mnos pa'i lo rgyus/ 213 tha tshe'i dbang bskur zab mo/ 217 da tshe sgrub zab mo'i las gzhung mdor bsdus/ 223 na grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshe dpag med rta mgrin gnyis kyi lo rgyus shin tu bsdus pa/ 229 pa grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshe rta dang drag dmar gyi dbang shin tu bsdus pa/ 235 pha yi ge brgya pa'i gzungs chog dbang bskur dang bcas pa/ 251 ba rdo rje rnam 'joms dang sme ba brtsegs pa'i lo rgyus bsdus pa/ 261 ma rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang khrus chog shin tu bsdus pa/

269 tsa rdo rje khyung khra'i dbang sgrub thabs las phran dang bcas pa jo bo nā ro pa'i lugs/ 285 tsha rdo rje khyung khra dang nā ga rakṣa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang shin tu bsdus pa/ 303 dza gza' yum gyi dbang khrus zab mo/ 319 wa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer mdor bsdus/ 331 zha 'jam dkar zhi ba blo'i mun sel/ 337 za 'phags ma dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa blo gros kyi 'dod 'jo/ 355 'a 'phags ma dbyangs can lha mo la bstod cing 'dod pa'i don gsol ba drug skyes mgrin pa'i rdza rnga/ 363 ya lo ma gyon ma'i gzungs chog shin tu zab pa/ 369 ra ḍā ki singha mu kha'i sgrub thabs/ 379 la mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg cho ga 'chi med lha'i ba dan/ 387 sha bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgo nas don gnyis sgrub pa 'chi med kyi 'dod 'jo/ 405 sa sman bla longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thabs dngos grub bang mdzod/ 453 ha g.yu thog snying thig gi bka' srung zhang blon drag po sde dgu'i phrin las gnam lcags kyi 'khor los sgyur ba/ 477 a sngon 'gro'i legs bshad shel dkar phreng ba/ 511 ki bla med rdo rje theg pa'i sdom pa'i bslab bya rdo rje'i phreng ba/ 525 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (cha)pa'i dkar chag / ka dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi zhal nye bar mthong tshul gyi lo rgyus nges pa rnam rol/ 1 kha rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi man ngag thams cad kyi rgyud/ 13 ga mgon po mched brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa/ 23 nga thub pa'i bstan pa srung ba'i ye shes kyi mgon po mched brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i dbang gi chu bo chen po/ 27 ca dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dngos grub kyi dga' ston/ 41

cha pal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang phrin las lhun grub/ 53 ja dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi phrin las dngos grub 'dod 'jo/ 69 nya thub pa'i bstan pa srung ba'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i man ngag log 'dren tshar gcod dngos grub stsol ba'i nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung*/ 125 ta ye shes mgon po mched brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i man ngag gi bskang gso dngos grub 'byung ba'i bang mdzod/ 153 tha dpal rdo rje nag po chen po brgyad kyi dngos grub srung zlog gi man ngag dgra bgegs nges par 'joms par byed pa gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mtshon cha/ 161 da mgon po brgyad kyi man ngag srog gi spu gri'i yig chung sngags dang dmigs pa'i kha sgyur/ 233 na thub pa'i bstan srung mgon po brgyad kyi sgo nas dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i man ngag srog gi spu gri/ 239 pa nag po chen po mched brgyad kyi las mtha' nyer mkhor bsdus pa'i phan thabs man ngag mchog dam pa skyon gyi grangs can/ 245 pha thub pa'i bstan srung dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i las mtha' man ngag gter gyi bang mdzod/ 257 ba dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bya rog gi mtshan can gyi gtor chen brgya rtsa'i lag len gsal ba las rim gsal sgron la sbyar/ 271 ma mgon po'i las rim gsal sgron gyi mchod pa kha 'gengs yig rnying ltar/ 285 tsa bde mgon gyi las rim gsal byed sgron me'i lhan thabs bsnyen sgrub kyi man ngag / 289 tsha gtor zlog bya mgo ma'i las bsgrigs bstan srung mtshon cha'i nyer mkho lhan thabs/ 301 dza ma mgon gnyis kyi gtor bsngos bsdus pa/ 313 wa bskang ba'i cho ga kun tu bzang po'i rol mtsho/ 319 zha stobs 'phrog nag po'i bsnyen sgrub bsdus pa/ 347 za lha chen stobs 'phrog nag po'i mnga' gsol/ 357 'a gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa'i gtor bsngos dang bsnyen sgrub/

367 ya dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral gyi dbang dang las bdag pho mo'i bka' gtad dang bcas pa byin rlabs gter mdzod/ 373 ra dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral gyi phrin las kyi rim pa dngos grub kun 'byung/ 387 la dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral las bdag pho mo dang bcas pa'i gtor mas las rab 'byams sgrub pa bar gcod kun sel/ 439 sha dpal ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen lcam dral las bdag pho mo dang bcas pa'i par bu nag po'i sgrub thabs gnam lcags thog mda'/ 485 sa dpal ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi rdzogs rim rdo rje'i tshig rkang/ 519 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (ja)pa'i dkar chag / ka bcom ldan 'das ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i cho ga rgya mtsho dga' ba'i snye ma zhes bya ba/1 kha bcom ldan 'das ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i cho ga'i lhan thabs dpag bsam snye ma/ 161 ga ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gtsug tor dgu'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od kyi snye ma/ 201 nga kun rig gi sgrub thabs dang dbang shin tu bsdus pa/ 245 ca bcom ldan 'das ngan song yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi chog bsgrigs don gsal ngag gi 'dod 'jo/ 61 cha phyag rgya bzhi'i zur 'debs/ 367 ja mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs gzungs chog dang bcas pa/ 379 nya rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi rta mgrin dregs pa dbang sdud kyi dbang bskur bar chad kun sel/ 387 ta chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi smin grol las tshogs 'khyer bder bsdus pa phreng ba skor gsum gyi lo rgyus mdor bstan pa/ 403 tha chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi sgrub khog chen mo dang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i lag len padma rā ga'i phreng ba/ 441 da rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi bsdus don phreng ba skor gsum gyi lhan thabs ma ṇi bum sgrub/

513 na chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi bskyed rim skor gyi las tshogs drug skor drug pa dang*/ rgyun 'khyer las tshogs bsdus pa dang bcas pa yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba/ 523 pa chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi bskyed rdzogs 'gag don bsdus pa'i khrid yig padma dkar po'i phreng ba/ 573 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (nya)pa'i dkar chag / ka bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i dkyil chog dbang rdo rje'i phreng ba/ 1 kha bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i sgrub thabs rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor*/29 ga bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun gyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus/91

nga dpal kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i sgrub thabs dkyil chog rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i phreng ba/75 ca dpal kun tu kha sbyor gyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i dkyil chog dbang gi chu bo/147 cha dpal dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i cho ga shin tu bsdus pa don gnyis mchog stsol/295 ja dpal sambu ṭa nas gsungs pa'i dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/359 nya dpal sambu ṭa'i dgongs pa dgyes pa rdo rje mtshon cha can lha bcu bdun gyi mchod pa'i cho ga dkyil 'khor bzhi'i dga' ston/421 ta sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sgyu 'phrul mchog sbyin/469 tha sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul mchog grub/565 da sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga sgyu 'phrul las sgrub/597 na bla med lhan skyes rnam bzhi'i rdzogs rim snying po don gyi phreng ba u pa de sha gaṃ bhī ra/617 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (ta)pa'i dkar chag / ka rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i chos kyi byung tshul rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dga' ston/ 1 kha dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang gi chu bo dngos grub 'dod 'jo/91 ga dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus dkyil mdor bsdus dril bu zhabs kyi zhal lung*/129 nga dril bu lus dkyil shin tu bsdus pa/179 ca grub mchog dril bu lugs kyi bde mchog rim lnga'i rdzogs rim gyi dmigs skor tshang ba'i gsol 'debs dngos grub mchog stsol/191 cha bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i sgrub dkyil mar me mdzad kyi zhal lung*/201 ja bde mchog lha lnga'i cho ga snying po gsal ba/255 nya dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga shin tu bsdus pa/327

ta 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga rga lo lugs kyi sgrub thabs don gnyis kyi 'dod 'jo/345 tha 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga rga lo lugs kyi dkyil chog dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo/379 da sgrub dkyil 'dod 'jo kha bsgyur te dril bu lha lnga bya ba'i nyer mkho/481 na bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs lū hi pa'i lugs yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'bar ba/495 pa lag pa'i mchod pa rgyas pa dang phyi rol mchod pa bsdus pa tshogs gnyis kyi 'dod 'jo/557 pha dra ba sdom pa'i yi ge bdun gyi rnam par bshad pa/569 ba rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs mchod phreng dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur ba thar pa dam pa'i gru rdzings/ 573 ma dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas las bzhi'i sbyin sreg 'dod don kun sbyin/625 tsa gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga phrin las kun 'grub/657 tsha e waṃ gyi rnam par bshad pa legs bshad nor bu'i tog/725 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (tha)pa'i dkar chag / ka dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi them byang padma'i phreng ba/1 kha dgongs pa yang zab kyi smin grol sbyin pa'i tho yig /13 ga dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gnyis myur 'grub/19 nga zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog don gnyis myur 'grub zhi khro'i dbang phreng la sbyor tshe bum bskyed kha bsgyur/53 ca dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga don gnyis myur 'grub kyi kha sgyur lhan thabs dgos 'dod myur 'grub/59 cha dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ rgyal ba zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi skong bshags na raka dong sprug gi cho ga tshogs gnyis myur 'grub/113

ja dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi las byang rtsa ba gsum gyi bskang ba bshags zlog bsam don myur 'grub/141 nya bstan srung gsum la rtags dang don gyi sgo nas rdzogs pa chen po gnyis med a ti yo ga ltar bstod pa tshangs dbyangs lha'i rnga chen/147 ta 'chi med tshe'i skor gyi dbang gnad zab tshe'i dbang bskur gyi las byang dbang dang bcas pa/153 tha bla ma tshe dbang 'dzin pa'i las byang*/167 da dam chos dgongs pa yab zab las: tshe'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i bla ma gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi las gzhung*/181 na dam chos dgongs pa yang zab zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dge legs myur 'grub/211 pa dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang gi kha skong phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa/239 pha dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg phrin las myur 'grub/265 ba dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi sātstsha'i cho ga phan bde myur 'grub/287 ma rtsa gsum rnal 'byor bsdus/295 tsa gtum mo ye shes rab 'bar gyi 'khrul 'khor/301 tsha sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi spyi dang bye brag bde gshegs 'dus pa'i chos kyi byung tshul 'khrul med yid ches drug ldan/305 dza bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang sgrub kyi lag len dmar khrid brjed byang*/363 wa sgrub chen bka' brgyad nyang lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshon yig lha mtshan shes ldan mkhas pa kun gyi dgongs rgyan/393 zha bde gshegs 'dus pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi bskyed rdzogs 'bring po'i las byang mdor bsdus pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo/401 za chos sman gyi dkar chag gsal ba'i me long*/465 'a gang shod du bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun dkar chag /481 ya bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sman sgrub gyi sngags byang zur du bkol ba/491 ra bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gtor zlog phrin las myur 'grub/495

la sgrub pa bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga dngos grub kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba dbang gi rgyal po/769 sha bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i 'cham yig brjed tho/823 sa bla ma dgongs 'dus spyi dril gyi sgrub pa las bsdus pa nor bu'i snying po/841 ha kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi zhi khro'i las byang padma'i phreng ba'i lhan thabs dus mtha'i cho ga thar pa'i lam ston/867 a bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rdzogs chen snying po shel gyi bum pa'i dngos gzhi nyams len rgyun 'khyer nyin mtshan rnal 'byor dus bzhi mnyam sbyor gyi gdams pa/895 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (da)pa'i dkar chag / ka yang zlog me'i spu gri'i lo rgyus rgyas pa/ 1 kha yang zlog me'i spu gri'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/37 ga yang zlog me'i spu gri'i dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon/47 nga yang zlog me'i spu gri'i dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi nyer mkho lhan thabs kyi rim pa/129 ca phyag rgya zil gnon zhi bar sgrub pa'i thabs/159 cha yang zlog me'i spu gri'i lo rgyus las/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud rnams nas bshad pa'i dam tshig gi rim pa/175 ja gshin rje'i gshed yang zlog gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/187 nya yang zlog gi ngag 'don rgyun gyi nyams len bkol zhing bsgrigs pa/191 ta zla gsang las rgyun bsnyen gyi zhal gdams shin tu gsang ba/237 tha yang zlog me'i spu gri dang gnam thog me'i skor gyi nyams len don bsdus snying por dril ba rnam dag rdo rje dgyes pa'i rol mo/241 da yang zlog me'i spu gri'i kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo/253 na 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bskang ba dang bshags pa dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo/269 pa 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gi gsang ba gsol gdab dang mnga' gsol gyi rim pa/285

pha 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag nag po la rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa gshin rje 'joms byed/297 ba phyag rgya zil gnon gtso 'khor la bstod pa/309 ma ya mā ra'i bstod pa phreng ba 'dzin pa can/313 tsa yang bzlog me'i spu gri'i gtor mas bzlog pa'i las sgrub pa'i lag len gyi tho yig/319 tsha yang zlog me'i spu gri'i zlog pa'i phrin las kyi gzhung bsrang ba/327 dza yang zlog me'i spu gri la nye bar mkho ba'i zlog byang a ti/345 wa yang zlog me'i spu gri las/ phur gdab kyi man ngag gud du bkol ba/359 zha zla gsang las sku gzugs dbang po skyon sbyang rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga/377 za zla gsang las sku gzugs dbang po skyon sbyang rab gnas kyi cho ga'i lhan thabs/457 'a 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed phyag rgya zil gnon gyi phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi lag len dang ngag 'don dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo/467 ya ya mā ri'i sbyin sreg dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i kha skong lhan thabs phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi sbyin sreg bya ba'i tshul ches zab pa/529 ra zla gsang las/ dus tha ma'i cho ga sgrib sbyong gnas spar gyi lag len/541 la zla gsang las/ sreg sbyong gi lag len dang ngag 'don/565 sha zla gsang las/ bsad pa mthar thug gdug pa me'i las sbyor/591 sa gdug pa me'i las sbyor gyi kha bsgyur las phran rnams/601 ha 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed yang zlog me'i spu gri'i rdzogs rim dbang bzhi'i rnal 'byor/613 a 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed phyag rgya zil gnon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ches zab cing gsang ba snying khrag lta bu/661 ki zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra'i snying po lus dkyil rdzogs rim dang bcas pa shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug pa/759 ku 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blang ba/771 ke 'jam dpal gshin rje zla gsang gi tshe sgrub 'chi bdag 'joms pa/791

ko 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dpa' bo 'bru gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/807 khi yang zlog me'i spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rnams kyi tshod 'dzin nang rtags drod tshad rgyud las byung ba/815 khu yang zlog me'i spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub kyi zhal gdams gud du sbas pa/831 khe zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi zhal gdams gab sbas snying dang 'dra ba/853 kho zla gsang gzhi bsnyen las/ don grub bsnyen pa'i bsdebs dang ma grub na ar la gtad pa ru khug gi las shin tu gsang ba/865 gi bsam gtan bum pa'i las mtha' rnam grol bdud rtsi'i phreng ba/871 gu ya mānta ka las/ gnas skabs 'byung po'i dbang po brgyad nye bar sgrub pa'i tho/881 ge las kyi gshin rje lha bcu bdun pa'i phrin las/891 go gshin rje du ba dum bu'i las byang*/913 ngi gshin rje gshed thams cad kyi bshad rgyud 'khrul 'khor rgyal mtshan me long las zhi ba rgyas pa dbang gi dgug pa rengs pa bskrad pa dbye ba drag po bsad pa rnams kyi 'khrul 'khor te 'khrul 'khor chen mo brgyad/927 ngu gshin rje dmar po'i rlung sgrub kyi las byang*/953 nge gshin rje dmar po rlung sgrub kyi zhal gdams rnams/973 ngo dgra mnan gshin rje dmar po rlung gi sgrub pa/987 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (na)pa'i dkar chag / ka bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po'i phrin las dgra bgegs tshar gcod srog gi spu gri/ 1 kha bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po'i phrin las dgra bgegs tshar gcod srog gi spu gri'i lhan thabs yig chung gud du sbas/67 ga 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor gyi phrin las snying po bsdus pa*/79 nga lcags sdig gi phrin las snying po bsdus pa las/ mngon rtogs rgyun 'khyer du bya ba mdor bsdus pa sa bcad tsam zhig/145 ca lcags sdig gi bstod bskul mdor bsdus/149

cha 'jam dpal tshe bdag lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs kyi dbang bskur bsdus pa snying po don gyi smin lam/153 ja 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs kyi las kyi mtha' sdud drag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga gdug pa kun sgrol/175 nya 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po gsang ba gnam thog me'i skor gyi gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum sogs chabs cig tu lag tu len pa'i ṭī ka rin chen phreng ba'i gsal byed khrigs chags su bkod pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon/191 ta rgol ngan 'joms pa lung rigs nyi ma'i snang ba/285 tha 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro chu dug gdong nag po'i las byang gdug pa kun sgrol/305 da gshin rje khro chu dug gdong nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bca' gzhi lag len shog dril rgyas pa/363 na gshin rje khro chu dug gdong nag po'i zhal gdams gces gnad yang gab sbas pa'i rgya can/395 pa khro chu dug gdong nag po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bca' gzhi lag len gyi shog dril bsdus pa/401 pha lhag pa'i lha bzhir dus gtor 'bul ba'i phrin las/413 ba 'jigs byed dmar po'i sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa/421 ma bshad pa'i rgyud khri drug stong pa'i dgongs pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi las byang bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba/427 tsa bshad pa'i rgyud khri drug stong pa'i dgongs pa rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i las byang bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang gi chu bo dngos grub kyi dga' ston/479 tsha 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas gtor mas las sgrub pa drug cu pa/505 dza las gshin gyi rgyun gtor shin tu bsdus pa gnam lcags kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/527 wa bshad rgyud khri drug stong par gsungs pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rnal 'byor rnam gsum/533

zha rdo rje gtsug lag gi rgyud kyi las byang ngag bsgrigs su khol bur byas pa nye bar mkho ba/541 za rdo rje gtsug lag gi phrin las drag po mngon du phyung ba'i las byang gi kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga phrin las kyi shing rta/567 'a rdo rje gtsug lag gi rgyun gsol mdor bsdus/593 ya rdo rje gtsug lag gi gtor 'bul/603 ra rgya mtsho dug ri kha'i gtad khram gsum thun mong gi phrin las klu'i dug mda' nag po/607 la srid pa gter khyim gyi rgyun gsol mdor bsdus/623 sha grib 'joms rdo rje pha lam gyi las mtha' grib mdos shin tu bsdus pa/633 sa gnyen po lha gsum gyi dbang dang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor sogs kyi kha skong tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dngos grub dga' ston/645 ha phung bshig 'khor lo nag po'i phrin las dug gsum me'i spu gri/653 a drang srong dri med kyi brgyud rim gyi gsol 'debs/695

ki loka tri pā la'i las sbyor gyi sgrub pa'i smad las kyi ngag 'don khrigs chags su phab pa/699 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (pa)pa'i dkar chag / ka phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi gtor dbang yid bzhin nor bu/ 1 kha phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi gsol 'debs/23 ga phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid kyi man ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/27 nga phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len rgyun 'khyer 'khrul med snying po/47 ca phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi ngag 'don byin rlabs dpal 'bar/71 cha phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len mdor bsdus ngag bsgrigs/87 ja zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mdor bsdus/89 nya nā ro'i chos drug gi rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig nyung ngur byas pa/93 ta zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi bka' bab nyams dang rtogs pa byin rlabs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dad pa'i lang tsho/97 tha chos drug dril ba'i gdams pa/105 da zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi khrid kyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa nā ro zhabs kyi zhal gyi lung bzang po/117 na 'khrul snang du dpal nā ro pas gnang ba'i tsaṇḍa lī dang 'pho ba zab pa/277 pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid yig rnam 'byed shing rta/285 pha rim lnga dmar khrid kyi gsol 'debs/417 ba dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim/ rim lnga gdan rdzogs kyi dmar khrid zab don nor bu'i phreng ba/425 ma rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa yid bzhin rin po che'i phreng ba/509 tsa rgyab mdun rlung 'jug thur ma'i man ngag/621 tsha myur lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'jag tshugs ma'i khrid yig padma can du bgrod pa'i pho nya/629

dza ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa mdor bsdus pa 'jag tshugs ma/661 wa bsnyen sgrub spyi la gces pa'i yig chung gambhī ra/669 ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (pha)pa'i dkar chag / ka bka' brgyud rin po che gser gyi phreng ba la bstod pa gsol 'debs dang bcas pa/ kha shog dril bzhi'i brgyud rim gsol 'debs/ ga lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i lo rgyus bsdus pa/ nga lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ smin lam dbang gi chu bo/ ca yang zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ phyi sgrub byin rlabs 'byung gnas/ cha lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ nang sgrub 'khor 'das rang grol/ ja lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ gsang sgrub ye shes rgya mtsho/ nya lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ de kho na nyid du sgrub pa spros bral mthar phyin/ ta lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las// rtsa rlung rdo rje'i phreng ba/ tha lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ rdzogs rim mnyam yangs mtha' bral/ da bla sgrub gnad ky-i zhal shes shin tu gsang ba/ na lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ gegs sel bde ba'i rdo rje/ pa lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ kha bsgyur gzhan phan snying po/ pha lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ kha bsgyur gzhan phan snying po'i 'phro/ ba rdo'i bcud len rin chen mchog gi gsang ba'i gter mdzod/ ma lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i kha skong las byang yid bzhin nor bu/ tsa lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ rgyun khyer rgyas pa/ tsha lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ rgyun 'khyer shin tu bsdus pa/ dza bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyung dur gdams pa rnams/ wa thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi rol mtsho/ zha zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsdus pa/ za rtog med don dam rdo rje'i glu zhes bya ba nges don phyag rgya chen po/ 'a rten rdzas dang snyan dar phul ba'i smon tshig dang 'dod gsol khag/ ya mnga' ris chos mdzad mar bstsal ba'i zhal gdams/ ra bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs brtan bzhugs ngag 'don du bkod pa/

la khams skyo dbon chung la gnang ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam/ sha brtan bzhugs kyi rim pa/ sa gsol 'debs smon lam gyi rim pa dad pa'i chu skyes bzhad pa/ ha smon lam gyi rim pa tshogs gnyis kyi rgya mtsho/ a phyag rgya chen po'i zhal gdams kyi skor/ ki yon bshad legs par phye ba'i gtam kun tu dga' ba'i phreng ba/ ku gshin po'i bsngo ba zur bkol rgyas par phye ba rgyu 'bras theg pa'i lam rim yongs su tshang ba/ ke gser 'od dam pa'i mdo'i le'u las bshags pa'i smon lam mdor bsdus bris pa/ ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (ba)pa'i dkar chag / ka legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyis brda sprod pa ka lā pa'i mtshams sbyor gyi rgyas 'grel mu tig gi phreng ba/ kha shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po nyi shu lnga pa skad gnyis shan sbyar ba/ ga sngags kyi bklag tshul dang yi ge'i khams kyi sdeb sbyor mdor bsdus don gsal phrin las kun grub/ nga snyan ngag me long gi rgyan gyi dper brjod gzhon nu dga' ba'i gtam ngag gi 'dod 'jo/ ca rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rjer snyan ngag gi bstod pa ka la piṅka gsal bar byas pa/ cha rin chen grang sbyor ril nag gi sngon byung gleng gzhi/ ja rin chen ril nag chen mo'i zin bris brtan g.yo'i bcud bsdus mkhas pa dga' byed/ nya rin chen grang sbyor ril nag gi kha skong ldum sman gyi man ngag/ ta rin chen ril bu 'thag thabs kyi zhal gdams/ tha kong bu 'dag sbyor zhal gdams/ da ril nag 'bring po dang chung ngu'i zin bris 'chi ba bshol 'debs/ na grang sbyor ril nag grangs nges brtag pa mu tig gi phreng ba/ pa grang sbyor ril nag gi phan yon mos ldan dga' ba'i dbyar rnga/ pha rin chen ril bu gtong tshul gyi zin bris/ ba rin chen ril bu'i cha lag sbyar dug gso thabs/ ma rin chen grang sbyor ril bu'i cha lag phran bu'i dug gso thabs/ tsa

rin chen tsha sbyor gyi zin bris gcong nad bde ster/ tsha rin chen ril nag che 'bring chung ngu'i sbas don gsal byed nam mkha'i nor bu/ dza nyer lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba rin chen srog gi rgyab rten/ wa 'bam bcos tshe 'dzin srog skyob/ zha rims gcod gud du bkol ba rin chen srog gi zhags pa/ za sa bdag lto 'phye chen po brtag pa rab tu byed pa'i nyes pa kun sel/
